screen.awaken.table.hint: Lay it out on the table. Take what you make from the right. Sneak as you open it for the usual screen.
screen.awaken.furnace.hint: Cook on the left, add fuel below, and take finished items on the right. Sneak as you open it for the usual screen.
screen.awaken.anvil.hint: Lay the piece on the anvil and what mends it beside it. Click the line to name it. Take it from the right.
screen.awaken.smithing.hint: Lay the template, the piece and the material in a row. Take the finished piece from the right.
screen.awaken.grindstone.hint: Lay a piece on the stone to grind its enchantments off, or two of a kind to mend one. Take it from the near side.
screen.awaken.stonecutter.hint: Lay the block on the left, pick a cut below, and take it from the right.
screen.awaken.cartography.hint: Lay the map on the left and paper or glass beside it. Take the new map from the right.
screen.awaken.brewing.hint: Stand a bottle on each arm, put what brews them on top, and blaze powder at the foot.
